Dharmendra Pradhan Steps Down as Education Minister After Two Previous Resignations, Citing Paper Leak

Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan submitted his resignation to the Prime Minister on March 10, citing a paper leak. This is not the first time he has resigned; he had done so twice before in 1992 and 2019. The opposition alleged that the government was trying to suppress dissent. Police claimed that they were investigating the matter. Pradhan's resignation comes after he faced criticism for his handling of the paper leak, which occurred 30 years ago.
